author: AuroraPerego
body: #### PR description: When setting TICLv5 as the default, the superclustering default remained the run3 PF algorithm. This PR fixes it by setting the superclustering DNN as the default superclustering in TICLv5 and adjusting the TICL moustache process modifier. The PF mustache process modifier that was still in the code but is no longer used has been removed. A few collections in the TICL dumper have been set to the TICLv5 default. #### PR validation: Checked the event content and config for 38446.0 and 38446.204 before fix: after fix: FYI @waredjeb @felicepantaleo
title: Fix TICLv5 superclustering config
